axiom.exe is produced on a Windows runner (or a Windows machine), not in this Linux sandbox.

Build on Windows:
  cargo build --release
  # output: target\release\axiom.exe

Or via GitHub Actions (Release workflow on windows-latest):
  artifact: axiom-windows-x64.zip containing axiom.exe + README.txt

Required target:
  x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
